$description: M3 Spring physics tokens with spatial/effects distinction

spring.$description: M3 spring system. Spatial springs allow overshoot (position/scale/rotation). Effects springs are critically damped (opacity/color).

fast.$description: Fast springs for small components (buttons, switches, icons)

spatial.$description: M3 fast spatial spring. Position, scale, rotation for small elements. Allows overshoot.

effects.$description: M3 fast effects spring. Opacity, color for small elements. Critically damped, no overshoot.

default.$description: Default springs for standard UI transitions

spatial.$description: M3 default spatial spring. Position, scale, rotation for standard UI. Allows overshoot.

effects.$description: M3 default effects spring. Opacity, color for standard UI. Critically damped, no overshoot.

slow.$description: Slow springs for full-screen and large element animations

spatial.$description: M3 slow spatial spring. Position, scale, rotation for large elements. Allows overshoot.

effects.$description: M3 slow effects spring. Opacity, color for large elements. Critically damped, no overshoot.

selection-guide.$description: How to select the right spring

legacy.$description: Previous spring tokens for backward compatibility. Use M3 springs (fast/default/slow + spatial/effects) for new implementations.

standard.$description: DEPRECATED: Use spring.default.spatial. Standard spring (Framer Motion convention).

snappy.$description: DEPRECATED: Use spring.fast.spatial. Snappy response (Framer Motion convention).

bouncy.$description: Custom bouncy spring (not in M3). Low damping for playful overshoot.

gentle.$description: DEPRECATED: Use spring.slow.spatial. Gentle settle (Framer Motion convention).

celebratory.$description: Custom celebratory spring (not in M3). Extra bouncy for celebration moments.

calming.$description: Custom calming spring (not in M3). Very gentle for relaxation.

urgent.$description: Custom urgent spring (not in M3). Fast and crisp for urgency.

energetic.$description: Custom energetic spring (not in M3). Quick with some bounce.

mysterious.$description: Custom mysterious spring (not in M3). Very slow and smooth.

conversion.$description: Convert M3 springs to Framer Motion / React Spring convention

$value.note: M3 uses damping ratio (0-1), Framer uses damping coefficient. Approximate conversion provided.
